title: Love it but much to work on
body:
I genuinely loved this app. I have ADHD so my organisation skills are pretty much inexistent. Brili has helped me keep track of time primarily. Setting up and starting routines is super easy and i really felt empowered to make the most out of today but using this app.

Truth be told it has some bugs. The biggest problem I encountered was a routine restarting each time i went elsewhere in the app (without clicking the quit routine button of course ). The routine would still be running because i would recieve notifications and reminders for each task, but when clicking back on it from the “scheduled routines” menu, it would restart as if i were using the “on demand” function.

It would also be great to have more control over the star earning system
author: nicknameistakenenteranickname
